atlas.why: dim underwater trading place with fish on different sides of the goods: light and blocking for Trout's side (trade skiff); nothing from it asked to appear

takes.seen: 0-3 s cockpit matches the master (chipped six-bolt port, empty slot, chalk chart, toggle, lamp, dent); Turkey's tail fan enters at the lower right from about 1 s and by 1.7 s an amber cone of light lies across the console and Turkey's face is reflected low right in the glass; 3.3-5.5 s push-in to the glass: a raft of upside-down glass jars netted in knotted brown rope hangs on ropes from the surface, air pockets pale in the jar tops, a green pickle lying on top, trout below over mossy stones; about 5 s a trout noses one jar up under the middle of the raft and by 5.9 s the trout is upright against the netting; about 6.3 s the outside view appears still ringed by the brass port rim, which is gone by 7 s; 6.3-8 s riveted metal tin with handle on the riverbed, Turkey small behind the amber port, the jar raft filling the top of frame, a wicker basket on a rope lowered from the raft with a jar in it; at 7 s a trout is at the basket and a small round disc hangs beside it; at 7.7 s two trout face in from left and right

open: the cut across the glass is not a hard cut: at about 6.3 s the outside view is seen through the brass port rim, which then slides off frame
Turkey's tail fan and back fill the lower right corner from about 1 s to 3 s instead of a wing tip only; the port and chart stay clear, but no wing is seen flipping the toggle
the lamp beam reads as a cone of light falling on the console inside the room, not a beam outside below the port
bottle-cap-opener reading is not supported: no bottle is seen and no cap is popped; only a small round disc beside the trout at about 7 s
trade-skiff reading is half there: the basket comes down with a jar in it, but no trout puts a button or anything else in, so no exchange is visible
pickling-factory reading is thin: the pickle lies on top of the raft rather than inside a jar, and nothing is being packed
the rope loop cinching the new jar is not visible; the bricolage rule shows only as the netted mismatched jars and one jar being added
in the outside view the basket and its jar hang in front of the right side of the port at 7-8 s, partly over the latch and the dent
the dent on the tin's right wall is visible at about 6.3 s but hidden behind the basket afterwards
trout count drifts: three or four below the raft through the port, one at the basket, then two different trout at the frame edges at 7.7 s
the dim trading-place light of a51 is not visible; the outside view is as bright as the master
sound not judged (sheet and stills only)
